crossRefs.note: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill…
Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
